response.sql: WITH combo AS (SELECT s.transref AS transref, t.tradekind AS tradekind, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_ovr FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord r ON s.transref = r.transreg JOIN trader t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind), base AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ovr) AS baseline FROM combo), dev AS (SELECT c.transref, c.tradekind, c.avg_ovr, c.avg_ovr - b.baseline AS deviation FROM combo c CROSS JOIN base b WHERE b.baseline IS NOT NULL), typed AS (SELECT d.*, AVG(d.deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY d.tradekind) AS type_avg_dev FROM dev d), kept AS (SELECT tradekind, avg_ovr, deviation, deviation - type_avg_dev AS excess FROM typed WHERE deviation > type_avg_dev) SELECT tradekind, AVG(avg_ovr) AS avg_optvolrt, AVG(deviation) AS avg_deviation, AVG(excess) AS avg_excess FROM kept GROUP BY tradekind

assumptions.assumption: Combinations with NULL tradekind still count in the baseline (they are only dropped at the comparison with the type average), and combinations whose average optvolrt is NULL are ignored by the averages.
